name: @w6w-apps/exa
description: AI-native web search, content retrieval, and answers via Exa.

w6w.longDescription:
Exa is a search engine built for AI: instead of ten blue links, it returns embeddings-ranked, LLM-summarized web results built for a workflow to consume directly. This app covers its core surface — Search (prompt-engineered web search with several latency/depth modes), Get Contents (crawled text/highlights/summaries for known URLs), Find Similar Links (semantic similarity search from a seed URL), and Answer (a direct, cited answer synthesized from web search) — plus a slice of the newer Websets API, which runs an ongoing entity search (companies, people, publications, ...) rather than one page of results: create, look up, list and delete a Webset, and list the items it has found.

Exa charges per call rather than by subscription, which shapes two choices here: the auth connection test and both health checks read GET /v0/teams/me (free account metadata) instead of a live search, and a dedicated health check declares the one thing the API genuinely does not expose — a queryable prepaid credit balance — as absent rather than guessing at it.
